## **Posting for another group member who wishes to stay anonymous**

Hi everyone! After an 8-year process, my Israeli partner and I had our final interview last October at the Jerusalem branch (Shlomo HaMelech Street) for my permanent residency application. I was told that it could take anywhere from 2 to 6 months to receive a decision, but I haven’t heard anything from them since then. I was wondering whether anyone else has had a similar experience, or if I should be concerned. Thank you very much!
